name: Aggie Ice Cream (USU Logan, UT) Salted Caramel with Milk Chocolate Truffles
brandOrRestaurant: Aggie Ice Cream (Utah State University, Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Made fresh from the cow to the cone at USU's Department of Food Science. Salted caramel ice cream blended with soft milk chocolate truffles is completely seed-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single baby or regular scoop in a dish; take a lactase enzyme tablet if lactose sensitive.
watchOuts: Contains dairy lactose and rich cream
